adr.rationale: Post-XT-013 review closed BR-01 and confirmed the byte-exact device-ID derivation, but BR-03 found that the required wrong-key vector is not a valid RFC 8032 public key, so ADR 0002 remains proposed.

architecture.rationale: The blocked review changes no runtime architecture; architecture synchronization remains an integration-owner action after ADR acceptance.

roadmap.rationale: The P0 milestone remains open while BR-03 blocks ADR 0002 acceptance; roadmap synchronization belongs to the integration owner.
